findings.message: The rewrite preserves the accumulation logic, but it drops the explicit behavior on bad input. The old loop implicitly skipped null/undefined line entries (throwing only on non-iterable input); the new reduce callback dereferences `line.quantity`, so any null/undefined element now throws a TypeError. This is a behavioral change for malformed/untrusted input and should be guarded (e.g., filter or explicit validation) if callers may pass sparse or null entries.
